item.title: Day 1 Deep Dive - Running an AI Agent on a Phone (Termux, no systemd)
item.description: The first message. systemctl: command not found. A nohup as service manager. proot Ubuntu, the search-backend war, Spotify OAuth from a phone browser, and the same evening's migration plan. 1123 words, 6 min read.
